title: LlamaIndex Extraction Agent
description: An extraction agent in LlamaExtract configured with a specific data schema and extraction settings for transforming unstructured documents into structured JSON representations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the extraction agent.

name.description: Human-readable name of the extraction agent.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the agent belongs to.

description.description: Optional description of the extraction agent and its purpose.

data_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the data to extract from documents.

prompt.description: Optional prompt used for automatic schema inference from example documents.

extraction_jobs.description: Extraction jobs that have been run with this agent.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the extraction agent was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the extraction agent was last updated.

ExtractionJob.description: An asynchronous extraction job that processes documents through an extraction agent.

id.description: Unique identifier of the extraction job.

extraction_agent_id.description: Identifier of the extraction agent used for this job.

status.description: Current status of the extraction job.

file_ids.description: Identifiers of the files being processed.

results.description: Extraction results for each processed file.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the extraction job was created.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the extraction job completed.

FileExtractionResult.description: Extraction result for a single processed file.

data.description: Structured data extracted from the file, conforming to the agent data schema.

status.description: Extraction status for this specific file.

error.description: Error message if extraction failed for this file.
